title: [4.5.2] Toggling between MeshInstance3D and Skeleton3D causes crash
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.5.2-rc1
- Not reproducible in 4.5.1, 4.6, 4.6.1

### System information

Godot v4.5.2.rc (b812a2817) - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8228) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-10400F CPU @ 2.90GHz (12 threads) - 15.89 GiB memory

### Issue description

- Appears in all renders (Forward+, Mobile and Compatibility)
- Does not happen in other 4.5 and 4.6 versions

- Open the mrp.
- Select MeshIntance3D -> Skeleton3D -> MeshInstance3D -> ... several times.
- Godot crashes.
